title: Workspace Shell multi-repo PADataset research access v1
goal: Extend the live Workspace Shell v1 lineage with a first-class PADataset target that supports exact-SHA/task-bound Git provenance, bounded read-only evidence inspection, and sandboxed network-denied research execution without exposing a generic shell or making the historical PADataset checkout writable.
acceptance_criteria: PADataset is an explicit Workspace Shell target authorized only by an IN_PROGRESS durable task capsule with an exact repository checkpoint SHA.
Read-only PADataset evidence inspection supports bounded recursive file listing, bounded byte reads, SHA-256 hashing, and existing hardened Git inspection without arbitrary shell execution.

research-bounded executes only approved PADataset Python research paths in the existing hostile-worker bubblewrap sandbox with network denied, credentials absent, and a disposable writable source copy.
Dirty/untracked PADataset state may be inspected by read-only profiles but may not be executed by research-bounded.
The historical PADataset checkout is never switched, reset, cleaned, stashed, deleted, or directly written by Workspace Shell.
Live upgrade is exact-head gated, snapshots PADataset read-only under /srv/workspace-shell, preserves rollback evidence, and leaves the four Workspace Shell services healthy.
Unauthorized targets, target/profile combinations, path traversal, oversized reads, arbitrary Python paths, and generic shell/interpreter escape shapes fail closed.
constraints: Do not weaken the existing distinct frontend/worker/tunnel/root-broker identities or credential isolation.
Do not expose /home to the hostile worker; PADataset reaches the worker only through a root-owned /srv snapshot.
Do not add unrestricted bash, sh, python -c, arbitrary executable lookup, PTY, background process, Docker socket, SSH agent, or outbound network access.
Do not mutate the historical PADataset checkout during bootstrap or Stage 00.
Privileged helper trust stores remain empty/fail-closed; this task does not authorize privileged helper execution.
Bind the clean PADataset execution source to exact SHA 4c095352bfe128e93f794112741efdb7a66b9c38.
Preserve the historical Lambda checkout in place as read-only evidence; do not require its branch/HEAD to match the clean execution source.
